name: sample_ID
description: A unique identifier assigned to each soil sample, constructed to ensure traceability.

name: sample_name
description: A unique identifier for each soil sample, combining field number, replicate number, depth interval, and location.

name: ID_field
description: Identifier representing the specific field from which the soil sample was collected.

name: ID_profile
description: Identifier indicating the within-field replicate number for the soil sample.

name: ID_depth
description: Identifier denoting the depth interval from which the soil sample was taken, with A for 0–5 cm and B for 15–20 cm.

name: ID_location
description: Identifier representing the administrative location where the soil sample was collected, with ATP for Attapeu and KHA for Khammouane.

name: depth
description: The soil depth interval from the surface over which the soil sample was collected, measured in centimeters.

name: landuse
description: The category of land use under which the soil sample was collected, such as rice, cassava, gardens, or non-cultivated.

name: volum_cylinder_cm3
description: The volume of the soil sampling cylinder used to collect an undisturbed soil sample, measured in cubic centimeters.

name: wet_mass_soil_g
description: The mass of the soil sample immediately after collection, including water content, measured in grams.

name: dry_mass_soil_g
description: The mass of the soil sample after oven-drying at 105 °C until constant weight, representing the dry mass of soil, measured in grams.

name: bulk_density
description: The dry mass of soil per unit volume, including pore space, measured using a soil sampling cylinder and expressed in grams per cubic centimeter.

name: water_content
description: The mass of water in the soil per unit dry mass of soil, expressed as a percentage by weight.

name: collection_date
description: The date on which the soil sampling occurred, formatted as YYYY-MM.

name: latitude
description: The latitude of the geographic location where the soil sample was collected, expressed in decimal degrees (WGS84).

name: longitude
description: The longitude of the geographic location where the soil sample was collected, expressed in decimal degrees (WGS84).

name: elevation
description: The elevation of the location where the soil sample was collected, measured relative to sea level in meters.

name: location
description: The administrative province where the soil sample was collected.

name: country
description: The country in which the soil sample was collected, represented by the ISO country code LA for Laos.
